evidence: The surface reaction chemistry during the Gd2O3 ALD process was studied by in situ QMS using a Hiden Analytical HPR-20 quadrupole mass spectrometer. The impurity concentrations in the Gd2O3 films were assessed by ToFSIMS using an IONTOF TOFSIMS IV instrument. XPS was carried out in a Theta300 system from Thermo Instruments. The Gd2O3 film thickness as well as the WiWNU were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry.
